decisions.reason: The 15-day express option overlaps with the broader express line and lacks prominent website placement, so its option value appears low and the firm drops it.
The 72-hour express program offers a distinct speed advantage and keeping it costs little while demand uncertainty remains, so the firm keeps the option open.
The fire-resistant exterior door is featured on the home page and has European approval, indicating realized value, so the firm keeps it.
The express delivery product line with several models has its own page and covers multiple segments, so the firm keeps this option to resolve demand uncertainty.
The online platform is a strategic digital option with its own page, and the firm keeps it because the shift to digital services still has high uncertainty and option value.
The fire and smoke protection door is only mentioned and overlaps with the featured fire-resistant door and existing range, so its marginal value is low and the firm drops it.
